════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  MURCIA ENVELOPE MAXIMUM
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  municipalities enumerated       33 / 45   ⚠ FIVE COUNTS, FIVE QUESTIONS — none is "the" answer

    45  CORPUS   — municipalities the regional planning register governs
                   SIT_USU_PLU_CARM:sitmurcia_plu_sp, one polygon per municipal term
    33  SCHEMA   — municipalities the zoning service actually CARRIES geometry for
                   SIT_USU_PLA_URB_CARM:plu_ze_37_mun_uso_suelo, distinct Municipio
    33  INSPIRE  — the harmonised HILUCS view of the same content (2nd workspace)
    37  CLAIM    — the string "37mun" in the LAYER NAME. ⛔ CONTRADICTED BY ITS OWN DATA.
    12  the gap  — governed by an instrument, NOT zoned in the service:
                   Albudeite, Aledo, Alguazas, Beniel, Cehegín, Las Torres de Cotillas, Librilla, Ojós, Puerto Lumbreras, Totana, Villanueva del Río Segura, Águilas

    ⛔ NOT RECONCILED SILENTLY: the layer name says 37 and the layer contains 33. Both are
       reported. The name is a publisher CLAIM about intent; only the data is a measurement.

  ── VALIDITY (established BEFORE measuring) ───────────────────────────────

    ⛔ THE BRIEF'S PREMISE IS REFUTED, and the refutation matters:
       "Murcia publishes f_fin"  — TRUE OF THE WRONG SERVICE. `f_fin`/`f_inicial` belong to
       the CITY of Murcia's MUNICIPAL GeoServer (geoserver.murcia.es). DescribeFeatureType
       on ALL 14 layers of the REGIONAL CARM service returns NO f_fin and NO per-row date.

       "superseded editions in separate layers" — a rival workspace DOES exist
       (SIT_USU_PLU_CARM). Tested on CONTENT, not on names:
         overlap on the genuine shared key (the ficha link): 100.00 %  (9 250 / 9 250)
         → HARMONISED INSPIRE VIEW, NOT A SUPERSEDED EDITION. No superseded zoning
           edition is served anywhere on this GeoServer.
       ⚠ a first attempt keyed on (Municipio, Uso, Area_m2) gave 5.41 % and would have read
         as "the editions disagree". It was float-precision skew in the key, not content.

    HOW CURRENCY WAS ESTABLISHED — positive evidence, not an absent flag:
      · BORM gazette citation of the governing instrument on 44/45 municipalities
        (100 % of the 33 zoned), and the links RESOLVE — HTTP 301 → live borm.es
      · validTo 0/45 and endLifespanVersion 0/45 — consistency check only
    NOT USED AS EVIDENCE:
      · ProcessStepGeneral = "legalForce" on 45/45 — ONE value in two casings, so ZERO
        INFORMATION. Same shape as Aragón fiab_geom and Balears DFIVIGEN.
      · regulationNature = "definedInLegislation" on 9 470/9 470 — likewise zero information.
    RESIDUAL RISK (stated, not buried):
      · IN FORCE ≠ RECENT. 14 of 45 plans are adapted to TRLS **1976**; median validFrom 2003.
      · Dataset BeginLifespanVersion is 2013-09-11 on 44/45. Whether every municipal
        amendment since has been re-ingested is NOT established by anything served here.
      · Area_suspendida="S" on 1.17 % of rows (acuerdos 2006-2009). Suspension is published;
        its LIFTING is not.

  ── TIER (a) · WFS ATTRIBUTES ALONE ───────────────────────────────────────

    WFS attributes alone            28.09 %   CONTROL: ✅ REPRODUCED — PASS
      23.51 % (packed ∧ not delegated, 17.663 / 75.145 M m²)
      + 8.81 pp × 0.520 resolve rate = 4.58 pp  →  28.09 %   exact match
      decomposition asserted to sum: 24.800 direct + 50.345 delegated = 75.145 ✓

    ⛔ BUT THE CONTROL AND THE FICHA CHANNEL ARE DIFFERENT UNIVERSES, AND CANNOT BE ADDED:
       28.09 %  = CITY of Murcia, ONE municipality, MUNICIPAL GeoServer, per-plot
                  calificación, denominator 75.145 M m².
       ficha    = 33 municipalities, REGIONAL CARM GeoServer, per-ÁMBITO (development
                  sector), a denominator that is neither subset nor superset of the above.
       Emitting "28.09 % + N" would be an unbalanced decomposition. It is NOT emitted.

    TIER (a) ON THE REGIONAL SERVICE, measured on its own denominator:
      buildable-now land            557.414 M m²  across 33 municipalities
        of which PRIVATE developable 507.613 M m²  (91.07 %)
        of which PUBLIC / systems    49.802 M m²  (8.93 %) — can never carry a private envelope
      ⚠ that public share is 8.93 % LAND-weighted but 44.94 % ROW-weighted.
        Murcia is far less public-heavy than Balears BY LAND (8.93 % vs 32.55 %) and far MORE
        so BY ROW. The two answer different questions; both are stated.
      ⚠ top 1 % of private records govern 22.27 % of private land; top 10 % govern 63.38 %.
      Edificabilidad with a VALID value: 60.31 % of buildable-now land
        (⛔ VALID, not present: 3 325 polygons carry 0, a null substitute in this corpus)

  ── TIER (b) · PLUS FICHA PARAMETERS  ← THE QUESTION ──────────────────────

    + ficha parameters              0 pp of DRAWABLE coverage
      complete rule                 0.00 %
      partial-drawable              0.00 %
      not drawable                  100.00 %       ← all 33 municipalities

    ⭐ THE FICHA CARRIES NO ENVELOPE PARAMETER. Its page is emitted by an Oracle stored
       procedure — the HTML opens `<!-- PROCEDURE FICHA ( WIde IN Number ) -->` — over a
       FIXED label set, read verbatim from the document, not assumed:
         Municipio · Superficie · Denominación · Nombre · Clasificación del Suelo ·
         Uso global · Aprovechamiento de referencia · Otros usos · Superficie total del
         ámbito de ordenación · Superficie neta del ámbito · Aprovechamiento resultante ·
         SSGG vinculados/adscritos · Densidad(viv/Ha) · Habitantes estimados por
         planeamiento · Nº de viviendas máximo · Viviendas estimadas · Observaciones ·
         Documentación adicional

       NO altura · NO plantas · NO ocupación · NO retranqueos · NO fondo edificable ·
       NO parcela mínima. It is a DEVELOPMENT-QUANTUM sheet — the same class of quantity as
       the `Edificabilidad` attribute: floor area and dwelling counts, NO SHAPE.

       CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY: the INSPIRE view carries `dimensioningIndication` — the
       INSPIRE model's own slot for dimensioning parameters — non-null on 0 of 9 470 rows.

    §4 CONSEQUENCE: footprint rule + height DRAWS; Edificabilidad alone does not. The ficha
       adds neither, so it moves NOTHING from not-drawable to partial-drawable. And the
       partials lever cannot pay: a partial needs SOME shape term to be partial ABOUT, and
       Murcia publishes none. Its published quantity is exclusively the FAR-alone-without-
       height tier that Balears measured at 1.6 % and could afford to discard.

    ⛔ REFUSED — THE n>=100 SAMPLE COULD NOT BE TAKEN. Stated as BLOCKED, never as 0:
       urbmurcia.carm.es sits behind a RADWARE BOT MANAGER WAF which IP-blocked this client
       after ~20 requests and held for the rest of the run (verified http and https, two
       paths, browser and bare UA). The seeded stratified sample (n = 132, 4 per municipality,
       seed 20260802) is BUILT and committed in 10-ficha-harvest.mjs; it needs an unblocked
       client to execute.
       Documents actually obtained: 1. Byte-hash control: 1 document, 1 distinct hash —
       reported as OBTAINED, NOT as a corpus rate.
    ⚠ OPEN RESIDUAL, NAMED: the stored procedure emits blocks labelled primer/segundo/
       tercer/cuarto/septimo for the one ámbito observed (Suelo Urbano Consolidado).
       QUINTO and SEXTO did not render. Their content is UNKNOWN. If they carry ordinance
       parameters for other ámbito types, the 0 % above would rise. UNKNOWN NEVER NO —
       so tier (b) is stated as "0 % on the evidence obtained", not as a closed finding.

  ── ARTICLE CITED (§5 — the rate that decides publication) ────────────────

    instrument citation (BORM)      97.78 %  of 45   ·  100 % of the 33 zoned
                                    resolves live (301 → borm.es). Cites WHICH PLAN IS IN
                                    FORCE — ⚠ NOT a parameter.
    parameter-granting article      N/A — there is no published parameter to cite one FOR.

    ⭐ THE POSED COMPARISON DOES NOT RUN, and that is the finding:
       Balears = PARAMETERS WITHOUT PROVENANCE (real PM 200 m² · NP 3 plantes · O 80 % ·
                 E 2.4, and only 3 of 60 cite an article).
       Murcia  = PROVENANCE WITHOUT PARAMETERS (a resolving gazette citation for 44/45
                 municipalities, and no parameter for an article to be cited for).

       ⛔ MURCIA IS NOT THE STRONGEST `P` IN SPAIN. It neither beats nor matches Balears —
          it is on the OTHER AXIS. On the axis that decides whether an envelope DRAWS,
          BALEARS STRICTLY DOMINATES MURCIA. Provenance cannot draw a solid.

  ── ADDRESSABLE OR VIEWER-ONLY ────────────────────────────────────────────

    addressable or viewer-only      ADDRESSABLE — but via an UNPUBLISHED REWRITE, and
                                    RATE-DEFENDED.

    · The URL PUBLISHED in `Enlace_ficha` is 100 % populated (9 469/9 469) and 0 %
      RESOLVABLE: http://opweb.carm.es/... returns HTTP 404, including its own root.
      ⭐ POPULATED IS NOT PRESENT. A pipeline trusting the attribute gets 9 469 404s.
    · The SAME URL over https:// returns 302 → http://urbmurcia.carm.es/urbmurcia/sitmurcia/...
      That rewrite is published NOWHERE. It was found by probing.
    · At the live host, a COLD BARE curl/8.5.0 client — no Referer, no cookie, no browser
      UA — was served the full ficha. So the capability is genuinely addressable, not
      viewer-only.
    · ⛔ BUT it is defended by a Radware Bot Manager WAF that serves a CAPTCHA WITH HTTP 200,
      and blocks by IP. Automation is possible but must be slow and will need block handling.

    ⭐ AND THE ROUTING IS REAL, RE-TESTED AGAINST THE COORDINATOR'S NATIONAL FINDING:
      9250 distinct links / 9250 distinct opaque `wide` ids over 9469 rows (97.7 % distinct);
      most-shared link covers only 43 rows; median multiplicity 1.
      ⛔ THE REPORTED ArcGIS DEFECT CANNOT FIRE HERE: this is GeoServer WFS 2.0.0, which has
         no `returnDistinctValues`/`resultRecordCount` pair; none was sent; and every distinct
         count was computed CLIENT-SIDE over a row set proven complete by
         numberMatched === features.length.
      ✓ Cross-checked anyway against a server-side GROUP-BY oracle (WFS hits per link):
        client and server counts agree on 5/5 probes.
      → This is PER-FEATURE ROUTING, not a register homepage (contrast València: 99 %
        coverage, 20 distinct — which fabricated a ~99 % tier estimate).
